timing: Locked after covariate-only audit and before new association results; follow-up sensitivity, not an original-study preregistration
population: Reuse explicit GEO individuals, author Tumor, stage I-IV
age: source years, linear nuisance effect, centered at69; age is not ranked
coding: Intercept plus age plus treatment indicators with first listed category as reference; no merging
sparse_rule: Any retained source category below3 prevents adjusted inference for that relation/model; do not drop or merge categories after results. Current M3 has counts1 and2 and is NOT_EVALUABLE under this support rule, despite full matrix rank.
effect: Pearson correlation between average-tie ranks of metabolite and RNA after separate OLS residualization against the fixed nuisance design
test: Two-sided approximate Freedman-Lane: rank RNA once, fit reduced nuisance model, permute reduced RNA residuals across independent individuals, add fitted nuisance values, refit nuisance residuals; compare absolute partial rank correlation (monotonic in full-model t). Do not rerank pseudo-outcomes.
permutation_assumptions: Independent individuals; exchangeable homoskedastic reduced-model errors conditional on nuisance design. Approximate with continuous nuisance; not an exact unconditional independence test.
bootstrap: Patient pairs bootstrap resampling x,y and covariates together; rerank x,y and refit fixed nuisance columns each draw. Exclude rank-deficient or constant-residual draws; percentile95% CI only if >=80% draws valid. Sparse category rule applies to original estimation sample, not each bootstrap draw.
seeds: SHA256 first8 hex of version|model|metabolite_key|human_gene_id for permutations; shared bootstrap draws per model and identical complete-case mask, seeded by version|bootstrap|model|mask. No selection based on seeds.
missingness: No imputation. Relation/model complete cases. Unknown categories excluded and counted. All original974 rows retained; outside674 are not tested.
M0_CC: Same complete-case sample as each proposed adjusted model, even if adjusted model lacks category support. If identical original inputs reuse exact original statistics; otherwise compute original Spearman kernel with new stable subset seed. Separate whole-family BH, never subset39 BH.
multiplicity: BH separately for every M1/M2/M3 and model-specific M0_CC evaluable family; report empty families and reasons. Models are separate sensitivities, not one union discovery test.
influence: Descriptive leave-one-patient-out partial rho; rerank/refit, require full nuisance rank and >=8 residual df; report invalid count and sign flips, no LOO tests
validation: Synthetic confounding/null/alternative and ties; compare independent lstsq residualization and full OLS t; compare identical-permutation direct refits; rank deficiency and constants; independent BH
